messages:
ash: Quick heads-up: new user report from onboarding funnel. quickstart-node throws schema validation when a tool call returns an empty payload under json_mode.

paula: Can you paste the error?

ash: Paste from logs: 
```
ERROR schema: expected object, got string
raw_tool_output: \"\"\"{}\"\"\"
stack: at parseToolOutput (lib/helpers/parseToolOutput.ts:82)
```

diego: That raw looks double-quoted. Could be a stringify in retry path or streaming-chunk assembler bug. Which SDK version?

ash: Node SDK v0.7.0 as used by samplekit v0.7.0 quickstart. Python quickstart (py-sdk v0.7.0) returns {} and passes.

rachel: Repro steps I used: 1) stub tool endpoint to 204 empty response, 2) run quickstart-node with JSON_MODE=true and STRICT_SCHEMA=true, 3) call `client.call({model: 'redwood-lite', tool: 'meta', json_mode: true})`. Fails reliably.

paula: I dug into parseToolOutput. There's a streaming branch that collects chunks and then runs `String(chunkBuffer)` and later `JSON.stringify` for a safe path. Looks risky.

diego: Also saw that our auth-retry interceptor returns a logged body in dev env by doing `JSON.stringify({payload: bodyBase64})` which, if invoked on an already-stringified body, creates nested quotes.

ash: Workaround for onboarding: updated quickstart-node to coerce stringy outputs: if typeof out === 'string' try JSON.parse and if parsed is null/{} convert to {}. Not ideal for long-term.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-5678: "node-sdk parseToolOutput double-stringify with streaming+retry" (assignee: diego).

paula: Plan: 1) tighten parseToolOutput so it strips a single level of wrapping quotes and attempts parse again, 2) audit auth-retry interceptor to avoid stringify-on-log in response path, 3) add a parity e2e that runs node+py quickstarts with stubbed tools and asserts identical outputs.

diego: I pushed a small guard in parseToolOutput that trims outer quotes and only JSON.parse once more. Added unit test for 204->{} and for quoted-objects. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/2510

rachel: I reviewed and left minor comments. Also suggested adding a test for the stream-assembler path (chunked responses).

paula: I'll own the auth-retry cleanup. Found one spot where we call `JSON.stringify({log: body})` even when body is a string. Fixing to use `log: bodyBase64` object without extra stringify. Will open PR.

ci-bot: DEVEX-5678 status: in_progress (assignee: diego).

diego: PR merged to main and cherry-picked to v0.7.x. Cutting node-sdk v0.7.1 patch now.

ash: Verified samplekit quickstart with node v0.7.1: empty tool payload now yields {} and schema passes. Onboarding signup provided confirmation.

paula: Opened follow-up ticket DEVEX-5679 to add CI gate that runs both quickstarts (node/python) with stubbed tools and compares outputs. Assigned to rachel.

rachel: Adding the parity CI job to sample-quickstarts repo. Will gate on PRs touching SDK helpers.

ash: Thanks everyone. Recommend we add a short note in the onboarding checklist for instructors: "bump quickstarts to v0.7.1 if you see json_mode tool issues".

ci-bot: DEVEX-5678 resolved. DEVEX-5679 opened.
